registrations.note: Both artwork versions use the same 1024-unit world calibration/grid. Geometry is not byte-identical: the current source is a newer drawing. Three widely separated exterior landmarks support coordinate-grid alignment within 2 source pixels. This does not independently validate a throw or every local geometry change.

Identity coordinate-grid registration reviewed on three circular landmarks and the full-map source/app overlay. Different artwork detail is retained. Publisher API marker coordinates are fractional image coordinates converted to logical1000; navigation is not a claim of independently game-tested physics.

Separable affine fit from three noncollinear circular landmarks spanning A and B. Reviewed whole-map overlay including distant CT and T-spawn boundaries. This registers navigation points between source radar drawings, not independently tested in-game grenade physics.
